_format: Cued-session protocols for the live trial page (sglab.cues). Edit freely; the server checks the file when the page loads.
protocol: id (letters, digits, _ -), name, summary, version, steps.
step: id, title (the big instruction), detail (smaller text), label (what the step is, for training), negative (true = should NOT count as a blink),
lead_in_s (instruction shown before the first cue, default 3), duration_s, cues, same_as (copy an earlier step by id, then override fields).
cues: {type: repeat, every_s, count, action, text, release_after_s, release_action, release_text}  - a beep every every_s s, count times
{type: sequence, every_s, items: [{action, text, gaze}], loop}                                   - items in turn every every_s s for the step
{type: timed, items: [{at_s, action, text}]}                                                     - items at fixed times after the lead-in
tone (per cues or per item): beep | release | tick | none.  gaze: ahead | up | down | left | right.

protocols.name: Cued blinks (about 10 min)
protocols.summary: Spontaneous blinks, blinks on a beep, long and half blinks, then look-arounds, faces, talking and taking the glasses off (things that must not count as blinks).

steps.label: spontaneous_blink
steps.title: Look straight ahead and blink naturally
steps.detail: Sit comfortably. No beeps for one minute - just blink as you normally would.

steps.label: cued_blink
steps.title: Blink once at each beep
steps.detail: One normal blink each time you hear the beep. 20 beeps, every 3 seconds.

steps.label: long_blink
steps.title: Close your eyes at the beep, open at the low tone
steps.detail: Keep them closed for about one second, until the lower tone. 10 times, every 4 seconds.

steps.label: half_blink
steps.title: Half blink at each beep
steps.detail: Lower your eyelids only halfway, then open again. 10 beeps, every 3 seconds.

steps.label: gaze_shift
steps.title: Look where the arrow points
steps.detail: Move only your eyes, not your head. Looking down can look like closing - that is why we record it.

steps.label: facial_expression
steps.title: Make the face shown, hold it until the next beep

steps.label: talk_head_turn
steps.title: Talk and turn your head
steps.detail: Chat with the operator and look around the room now and then, for one minute.

steps.label: glasses_off_on
steps.title: Take the glasses off, then put them back on
steps.detail: Follow the beeps. Sit still once they are back on.

steps.label: cued_blink
steps.title: Again: blink once at each beep
steps.detail: Same as before, with the glasses back on. 20 beeps, every 3 seconds.

protocols.name: Quick check (30 s)
protocols.summary: A short run to check the sound and the timing before the real one.
